decisive_technical_question: Can the dual invariant actually be maintained when one or more paths progressively fail?
answer_from_simulator: STRICT dual-invariant FAILS at peak ~22 mmHg under multi-segment progressive failure. GRACEFUL DEGRADATION succeeds: INV-2 (no path overload) preserved, INV-1 mildly violated (peak 22 vs 20 limit, far below catastrophic 40+). Strictly superior to single-segment baseline (peak 59 mmHg, 0/5 survive).

step_1_predict_occlusion.method: Trend-based detector on per-segment observed conductance G_obs_i = F_obs_i / p_obs
step_1_predict_occlusion.mapping: ratio >= 0.95 -> P_occl=0; ratio <= 0.5 -> P_occl=1; else sigmoid in log-space
step_1_predict_occlusion.provenance: MODEL_DERIVED. Tuned in this round after first falsification showed threshold 0.7 never fired. Buyer must re-tune on bench with real occlusion timecourses.

step_2_isolation.rule: If P_occl_i >= isolate_threshold AND not already isolated, isolate segment i (set alpha_cmd_i = 0)
step_2_isolation.fail_safe: Once isolated, segment remains isolated until manually reset (avoids oscillation)

step_3_pi_controller_on_total_conductanc.K_p_provenance: MODEL_DERIVED. Initial value 0.002 was too low (controller couldn't track lesion decay). Increased 10x in this round after first falsification. Buyer must tune on bench.

step_5_inv2_cap_per_survivor.rationale: At observed p_obs, this is the alpha that would make F_i exactly F_MAX. Going higher would violate INV-2.
step_5_inv2_cap_per_survivor.edge_case_p_obs_near_zero: If p_obs < 0.1 mmHg, cap doesn't bind (set alpha_cap=1.0)

step_6_dual_invariant_conflict_policy.trigger: When INV-2 cap binds on any survivor, realized G_total < G_total_target
step_6_dual_invariant_conflict_policy.policy: PRESERVE INV-2 (no path overload). ACCEPT INV-1 violation (P_ICP rises above P_TARGET).
step_6_dual_invariant_conflict_policy.rationale: Path overload causes localized tissue damage (slit ventricle, focal injury) faster than mild ICP elevation causes global symptoms. The lesser of two harms.
step_6_dual_invariant_conflict_policy.honest_disclosure: This is the design choice the simulator EXPOSED. The strict dual-invariant claim in element 1 of the TTP must be revised to reflect this policy.

design_limits_identified.limit: Strict INV-1 ceiling is 22 mmHg, not 20 mmHg, under multi-segment failure with current valve geometry
boundary_pushed_by: Increase F_MAX_PER_SEG (larger catheter ID, more flow capacity per segment)
Increase n_segments (5 or 6 segments, more redundancy)
Add accumulator buffer (elastic chamber that stores CSF during peak production)

design_limits_identified.limit: Predictor fires ~34 min after lesion onset (with 1/hr decay). For faster-progressing obstructions, predictor may fire too late.
boundary_pushed_by: Tighter threshold (more false positives, but earlier true positives)
Better signal processing (Kalman filter, Bayesian change-point detection)
Direct obstruction sensor (optical, impedance) instead of inference from F/P

what_the_buyer_must_tune_on_bench: F_MAX_PER_SEG — physical limit set by catheter ID and valve max opening
All thresholds are MODEL_DERIVED (Article XXVII). Buyer MUST re-tune on bench with real occlusion timecourses before any clinical claim.
